notes: Monthly Treasury Statement for June 2025 (40 pages as served, untagged, produced by PDFium), cut to pages 1-10 with pypdf (see holdout2/SELECTION.md): page 1 cover (banner, title block, photograph, seal), page 2 blank, page 3 Highlight box, Contents and Introduction, page 4 Figures 1-2 (Sankey diagrams), page 5 Tables 1-2, pages 6-8 Figures 3-8 (bar and pie charts), page 9 Table 3, page 10 Table 4; the Contents lists Receipts on page 10 and Outlays from page 11, which is not in the file. Not checked because they may be images: the cover (title block, banner), the figures, their titles, labels and 'Source data' lines. Headings: the bold 'Highlight', 'Contents' and 'Introduction' and the four bold capital subheads of the Introduction. Table titles are captions (two are must_contain phrases and four are ordered anchors, because this document's body after page 3 is tables). Tables: Table 1 is complete (header, the two fiscal-year label rows, 21 month rows, two Year-to-Date rows); its FY 2025 May Outlays value is printed with a superscript note mark in front ('¹686,881') and is left as an empty (unscored) cell because the mark's position in the text cannot be seen. Table 2 is complete; the four '......' (no transactions) cells are left empty because the dot count is not legible with certainty. Header cells are printed on two to four centred lines and written joined with spaces; superscript note marks are written attached ('Fiscal Year¹', NFKC '1'). Label-only rows ('FY 2024', 'Total On-Budget and Off-Budget Results:', 'Means of Financing:', 'Budget Receipts', 'Social Insurance and Retirement Receipts:') are rows with empty value cells. Table 3 is PARTIAL (its outlays section is not transcribed) and Table 4 is PARTIAL (rows without '......' or '--' were taken: Corporation Income Taxes, two excise rows, Estate and Gift Taxes, Customs Duties, All Other); table_precision is therefore expected to be below 1 for a complete conversion. Its header row 1 has 'Classification' (spanning both header rows) and the three period groups spanning three columns each, written in the first column they cover. Negative values and '(-)' are written with ASCII hyphen-minus (assumed; the code point cannot be seen); '+' signs are kept. Arithmetic checked while typing: monthly rows sum to Year-to-Date within rounding, Outlays - Receipts = Deficit, on-budget + off-budget = total, receipts - outlays = surplus, financing rows sum to the total, gross - refunds = receipts, and the figures shared by Tables 1-4 agree. must_contain: 15 phrases, each printed once (the note 'These estimates are based on the FY 2025 Mid-Session Review' is printed twice and not used; no phrase with an apostrophe or hyphen). ordered: 4 anchors from the page-3 introduction, then the titles of Tables 1, 2 (its unhyphenated part), 3 and 4 on pages 5, 5, 9 and 10. Noise: only page numbers repeat, so noise is empty; the text has no line-end hyphenation, so absent is empty. BLIND PROTOCOL: chosen and answered before any converter or text extractor was run on the file; every check was typed from the rendered pages (pdftoppm at 90-230 dpi, read as images), and the PDF text layer was never read. Consequences: (1) text that may be an image (logos, mastheads, cover art, chart labels) is not checked; (2) invisible text-layer content cannot be known, so noise lists only VISIBLE repeated page furniture; (3) where the exact code point of a glyph cannot be seen (curly vs straight quotes, dash and minus variants), must_contain phrases and ordered anchors avoid it; headings, table cells and absent entries that cannot avoid it are noted per file.
